SemanticObservationV1.purpose: Provenance-bearing typed semantic assertion derived from an authoritative source record.
invariants: provenance must contain at least one exact source reference
contradictions are represented explicitly and never silently collapsed
semantic observations are derived projections and never become source authority

EvidenceRequirementV1.purpose: Machine-readable request for additional evidence without execution authority.
invariants: must not invoke acquisition, inference, Lambda, experiments, or materialization
raw model self-confidence alone is insufficient evidence for escalation

OntologySliceV1.purpose: Deterministic bounded schema/context slice for one task or query.
invariants: same semantic manifest and same context produce the same canonical slice
slice contains only relevant entity types/predicates and does not widen authority

CandidateActionV1.purpose: Proposed next action derived from semantic state; never an authorization.
invariants: candidate action cannot serialize ALLOW, AUTHORIZED, or equivalent
candidate action may suggest an action but cannot grant permission

DecisionEvaluationV1.purpose: Auditable policy-bound evaluation of a CandidateActionV1.
invariants: ALLOW requires explicit authority-owned POLICY_ARTIFACT context
missing or stale required authority context yields DENY or ABSTAIN
inferred/model-derived facts cannot create permission or obligation
execution receipt is null until execution actually occurs
